Name: Oak Bathroom Custom Furniture
Author: Robokit12
Description:
OUTDATED MOD! Please note! I don´t plan on modding anymore. But if someone feels like it don't hesitate to change/update and reupload any of my files. I wouldn´t mind it.

I was looking for bathroom furniture fitting the Vanilla game graphics. Couldn't find any, so here I am with my first attempt creating custom content.
 
[b]Includes:[/b]

Bathtub (animated)
Sink
Toilet (useable as chair)
Shower
Rug

All items can be bought at Robins Carpenter Shop.

A DGA version converted by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/124850573]NOAV7[/url] can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16536]here[/url].

 
[b]Installation:[/b] Just download the file and extract it to your mod folder.

Please note that items may conflict with other installed custom furniture if those were created with Platonymous Custom Furniture Mod! If this happens just open the BathroomOak.json file and change the "id" number to something else that isn´t used yet (e.g. 4 to 24).
 
 
[b]Created with:[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture Mod by Platonymous
[b]
[/b][/url][b]Requires [/b](at least for me)[b]:[/b]

SMAPI
Content Patcher 
Space Core
JsonAssets
Custom Furniture Mod
PyTK

Hope you enjoy :)!
